instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. Set in an outdoor covered training area with concrete flooring and white pillars under bright daylight. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands in a boxing stance, throwing a left jab. On the left, the man in the blue tank top (R2) blocks the punch with his raised black boxing gloves. The left glove of the man in the beige t-shirt connects directly with the defensive guard of the man in the blue tank top. In the background, a blurred bystander sits on a chair. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene.
